summary: Pure Assault Mode build featuring the 2026 support wave and base Synchros as allowed cards, with generic staples filling the gaps. Duel Evolution - Assault Zone and Nightwinged Cleric solve the classic restriction by allowing direct Extra Deck tributes and immediate Trap activation, fielding omni-negates and massive field wipes.

summary.title: Starters
points: Psi-Reflector is the premier 1-card Synchro starter: on summon it searches Assault Beast or any card mentioning Assault Mode Activate, then reveals Assault Mode Activate to revive Assault Beast from the GY while increasing its Level by up to 4 to make any Level 6-9 Synchro (most notably Level 8).
Assault Beast discards itself from hand to add Assault Mode Activate straight to hand, loading the GY with a target for Psi-Reflector.
Crimson Blader/Assault Mode reveals itself from hand to search Assault Mode Activate or any card that mentions it, such as Duel Evolution - Assault Zone or Psi-Reflector.
Duel Evolution - Assault Zone on activation searches any monster that mentions Assault Mode Activate from the Deck, finding Psi-Reflector or an Assault Mode boss.

summary.title: Opening: Psi-Reflector
steps: Normal Summon Psi-Reflector and activate its effect to search Assault Beast from your Deck.
Discard Assault Beast to add Assault Mode Activate to your hand.
Activate Psi-Reflector's second effect, revealing Assault Mode Activate to revive Assault Beast and increase Assault Beast's Level by 3 (making it Level 7).
Synchro Summon Nightwinged Cleric (or Stardust Dragon / Red Dragon Archfiend) using Level 1 Psi-Reflector and Level 7 Assault Beast.
Activate Nightwinged Cleric to fetch an Assault Mode monster from the Deck and Set Assault Mode Activate directly from your Deck or GY, enabling it to be activated during the current turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Stardust Dragon/Assault Mode tributes itself as a Quick Effect to negate any card or effect activation and destroy it, returning to the field during the End Phase to lock down opponent interactions.
Red Nova Dragon/Assault Mode banishes opponent's cards equal to the number of Tuners in your GY when summoned and negates opponent attacks.
T.G. Halberd Cannon/Assault Mode negates an opponent's Summon once per turn and banishes their Special Summoned monsters.
Red Dragon Archfiend/Assault Mode destroys all other monsters on the field when it attacks, clearing opposing boards instantly.
Junk Warrior/Assault Mode is unaffected by opponent monster effects and gains ATK equal to the combined ATK of all other face-up Assault Mode monsters.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Duel Evolution - Assault Zone pays 2000 LP to allow Assault Mode Activate to Tribute a required Synchro Monster directly from your Extra Deck, making Red Nova Dragon, Junk Warrior, and T.G. Halberd Cannon instantly accessible without ever Synchro Summoning them.
Assault Mode Activate tributes a face-up Synchro monster (or one from the Extra Deck under Assault Zone) to Special Summon its upgraded /Assault Mode counterpart from the Deck.
Assault Mode Zero acts as a Quick-Play Assault Mode Activate from the hand, and banishes itself from the GY to Set Assault Mode Activate from hand or Deck.
Assault Counter provides an omni-negate Counter Trap that stops any Spell, Trap, or monster effect activation while you control an Assault Mode monster.
Assault Teleport recycles a drawn Assault Mode boss back into the Deck to draw 2 fresh cards, while Assault Reboot swaps an active Assault Mode monster for a different one.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Psychic and Resonator engine packages are omitted in favor of a pure engine with generic staples. Black Rose Dragon/Assault Mode is left out as it has not yet been released in the TCG.

exclude.Black Rose Dragon/Assault Mode: Not yet released in the TCG.
